articles.title: Amateur Astronomer? Be a Kilonova Catcher!
articles.snippet: Neutron stars are the ultra-dense, city-sized leftovers of dead stars.  When they collide, they can release a brief flash of light called a kilonova.
articles.summary: Neutron stars are the tightly packed, city-sized leftovers of dead stars. When they crash together, they can release a short flash of light called a kilonova.
